description: A solar particle event alert mid-walk reroutes the crew from Channel west edge to the nearest terrain overhang and holds them there until the dose rate falls.

events.display_message: At Channel west edge: image the fractured bedrock.
events.recommended_action: Mark the bedrock imaging task done.

events.display_message: Solar storm: radiation rising. Shelter at the nearest overhang.
events.recommended_action: Route to the nearest shelter now.
Follow the route and enter the shelter.

events.display_message: Sheltered. Hold until the dose rate falls.
